Descriptions

This multifunctional living room table is the perfect combination of style, utility and innovation – ideal for modern homes. The coffee table is characterized by its practical double lifting mechanism, which includes a large and a smaller lifting plate. Both plates allow for easy height adjustment, so you can work, eat or relax comfortably without ever having to change your sitting position. Another highlight is the generous, hidden storage space under the lifting plates. Perfectly organized, you can neatly store books, magazines, remote controls or other everyday items. In addition, the two front cabinet doors ensure easy access. This hidden storage space is ideal for avoiding clutter in the living room. Thanks to its modern design, this coffee table fits seamlessly into any style of living. Whether in a Scandinavian ambience or in a minimalist living room - this table sets the perfect accent in your home. Clean lines, functionality and an individual design make this coffee table a must-have for every home. Treat yourself to comfort and style in one piece of furniture!
